caption: The new Spectrum tab in the analysis dock: wavelength range and step count next to Run — no plot until the first sweep.
MZI sweep 1500–1600 nm: one transmission curve per output pin with legend, periodic pass/dip fringes, and the dashed design-wavelength marker at 1550 nm.
Changing the end wavelength to 1700 nm re-runs the sweep automatically: axes rescale to the wider range and more fringes appear — no reload needed.
